 Learn more (Bloomberg) -- DoorDash Inc., the food delivery provider in talks to take over Instacart, moved its earnings release date forward by almost a week.

 The company now plans to report third-quarter results before the market opens on Oct. 29, rather than Nov. 4 as previously planned. It didn't give a reason for the change in its statement late Wednesday. 
 DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart parent Maplebear Inc. for roughly $17 billion, people familiar with the matter said this week. A deal for the grocery app could be announced as soon as this week, said the people. No final decision has been made and discussions could fall through. 
 The talks come as competition intensifies in the the grocery delivery sector. Instacart previously held talks about selling itself to Uber Technologies Inc., Bloomberg News has reported.
